question: I have just one thing to say to Odacchi as representative of all young maidens. SENOR PINK SHOULD NOT HAVE BEEN A THING! Just, NO!! That thing... C...could you possibly be into that kind of thing, Odacchi-sensei...? Representative Matsumokkuri
answer: OH, HE'S A THING!!! HE'S TOTALLY A THING!! Um, could you not take Senor so lightly? It says here that you're 17 years old, and yeah I get it, you youngin's tend to always judge a book by its cover, so just you wait, I'll show you soon. The epitome of manliness, that is! What it really means to be hard-boiled!! Just you wait--!
name: Ladies' Representative Matsumokkuri
